== Lore ==
{{Legendary unlock text|They needed to hold out a little longer—buy enough time for their partner to gain control of the cannon. They knew this dance all too well, and it was always exhilarating.}}

* In order to be able to purchase the {{rarity|ascended|ascended}} piece, the [[Ardent Glorious Legplates (skin)|Ardent Glorious Legplates skin]] or [[Glorious Hero's Legplates]] must have been unlocked. Additionally, a [[PvP Rank]] of 100 is required.
